title: 階段と足場付きのプール監視用高座椅子
titleEn: Elevated pool observation chair with access steps
description: プールサイドの監視位置に置く高座椅子と架台の一体型プロップ。開放された四脚架台、補強材、足元プラットフォーム、背面アクセス階段と連続手すり、高いスラット座面・背もたれ・肘掛けを造形しています。人、傘、救命浮環や救助道具は含みません。固定状態の外観用モデルで、監視・救助機能、荷重定格、避難・安全基準への適合を保証しません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.145 × 2.178 × 2.075 m、9,076三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A complete elevated observation-chair prop for a poolside viewing position, combining an open four-legged tower, braces, foot platform, rear access stairs and continuous handrails with a raised slatted seat, backrest and armrests. People, umbrella, lifebuoy and rescue tools are omitted. All parts are static appearance geometry; no observation/rescue function, load rating or access/safety-standard compliance is guaranteed. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.145 × 2.178 × 2.075 m; 9,076 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
